decisions.decision: pi's own contract (types.ts AssistantMessageEvent) makes partial the shared live response-so-far, not an event-time snapshot. Both sides serialize it when the consumer receives the event; pi's single-threaded runner happens to reach every event before producing the next, while barness's producer runs concurrently with the consumer without backpressure (spec I8/I9), so its view may already hold later deltas, blocks and block ends (including their signatures). Event-own fields (contentIndex, delta, end content), the terminal message and the Result are compared strictly; the live-view contract (one shared view, never behind the event being read, synchronized snapshots, settles on the final message) is asserted by the E01 offline E2E TestStreamLifecycle. A partial missing on barness or differing in identity fields stays pending.
decisions.ref: spec I8 累计部分响应; issues/04; ai/e2e/stream_lifecycle_test.go

decisions.decision: Spec Implementation Decisions §6 (工具参数保留原始 JSON 与增量): barness keeps the provider's raw argument JSON on every tool call as `rawArguments`, persisted with the message, so ValidateToolCall judges completeness from what the provider actually sent rather than from the display parse. pi keeps the same text only as its transient `partialJson` scratch buffer while a call streams: deleted at output_item.done and on error, but left on an unclosed call of a length-truncated message. Ids, names, parsed arguments, deltas and end events match; only where the raw text lives differs.
decisions.ref: spec Implementation Decisions §6 消息、历史与工具语义; issues/06

decisions.decision: Spec-defined extension (spec §9: 模块构造的缓存/亲和标识按租户和账户作用域派生，不直接传裸 session ID 或 TenantID). pi sends the caller's sessionId as is; barness sends a key derived from tenant, vendor account and session (SHA-256, 64 hex characters), under the same conditions (a session id and retention other than none). Asserted by the offline E2E TestOptions (key shape, headers carry the same key) and TestCacheKeyScope (stable per tenant, account and session; differs across tenants and accounts; never the raw id).
decisions.ref: spec §9; issues/09; ai/options.go cacheScope
